subject: [PATCH v5 15/19] selftests/mm: check that one khugepaged pass collapses one window

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch adds a new selftest to verify that the khugepaged daemon collapses one window in one pass. The test prepares an aligned window, records its source PFNs from pagemap, runs one full pass of khugepaged, and checks that the window came out collapsed with exactly one collapse attempt attributed to it. The test also verifies that the scan_sleep_millisecs is set to a minute to prevent the test from taking too long. This patch has been tested on x86-64 4K and arm64 64K architectures.
